title: Flexible Muscle-Based Locomotion for Bipedal Creatures
summary: A 2013 research demo of simulated bipedal creatures whose natural gaits are found by optimizing muscle-based controllers, with no motion capture or keyframe animation. It shows physics-based walking and running emerging from musculoskeletal models.
why: HN cites it as an earlier, smoother precedent whenever new learned-locomotion or simulated-walking work appears.
